# Proposal Template

**Document ID:** TEMPLATE-PROPOSAL

**Schema version:** 1

**Kind:** roadmap/status

**Lifecycle:** current

**Subject:** template for one concise unpromoted proposal

**Surface:** template

**Boundary:** global

**Authority role:** non-normative

**Mutation:** authored

**Indexing:** exclude

Create one file per idea under `docs/proposals/`. A proposal is not a
specification, commitment, scheduler entry, or required origin for promotion.
Keep it concise and link deeper evidence instead of copying it.

```text
# <Proposal title>

<extended document metadata using Surface proposal>

## <BOUNDARY>-PROPOSAL-001

**State:** idea
**Idea:**
**Rationale:**
**Constraints:**
**Promotion target:** investigation and owner decision required

**Aliases:** optional historical identifier
**Source:** optional link to evidence or review
```
